title: Build atomic models
action: Construct initial atomic structures for the four catalyst systems: isolated Co‑porphyrin, Co‑porphyrin on a single graphene layer, Co‑porphyrin on a 4‑layer Ni(111) slab, and Co‑porphyrin on a graphene/Ni(111) bilayer slab. Use reasonable adsorption sites and a vacuum layer of at least 15 Å.

title: DFT geometry optimisation – clean systems
action: Perform spin‑polarised DFT geometry relaxations for the clean systems (without adsorbates) using PBE+PAW, 500 eV cutoff, Γ‑point k‑sampling, DFT‑D3, energy convergence 10⁻⁶ eV, force convergence 0.001 eV/Å. Store the final total energies.
description: Intermediary file showing final total energies of clean systems; not scored.

title: DFT geometry optimisation – adsorbed intermediates
action: For each system, perform DFT geometry relaxations for OH*, O*, and OOH* adsorbed on the Co centre using the same settings as the clean optimisations. Obtain total energies of the adsorbed states.
description: Intermediary file with final total energies of adsorbate states; not scored.

title: Calculate Gibbs free‑energy steps and overpotentials
action: From the total energies, the provided ZPE/TS corrections, and the reference energies of H₂O and H₂, compute the OER and ORR free‑energy steps and the resulting overpotentials for all four systems. Write the results to results.json.
description: Final scored artifact: contains the free‑energy steps and overpotentials for pristine Co‑porphyrin and the three supported systems.
